title: Bulk Switch Backup Pro v2.5.0 Enterprise
releaseNotes: Bulk Switch Backup Pro v2.5.0 Enterprise: Added 25G Twe (TwentyFiveGigE) port tokenizer support, multi-token port parsing (100G Hu, 40G Fo, 25G Twe, 10G Ten), placeholder IP collision prevention via HostKey matching, hierarchical uplink tracking, and combined CDP/LLDP telemetry ingestion.
